goals.title: Reconcile every shipped migration rec
goals.description: Cumulative shipped:false-to-true flips after verifying effects landed in prod DB. Verified emitted key.
directives: Only flip after the DB effect is verified, never on commit presence alone

goals.title: Check outstanding migration recs each run
goals.description: this_run_checked=0 for extended periods while unflipped recs exist means the reconciler is idle. Verified emitted key.
directives: Short-circuit when there is nothing unflipped to check

goals.title: Confirm landed effects promptly
goals.description: this_run_flipped tracks how quickly landed migrations get credited. Verified emitted key.
directives: A rec checked 5+ times without flipping deserves a manual-review flag
